Audio clip of Tucker Carlson comparing Lindsey Graham's behavior to a drunk girlfriend during a DUI stop, in the context of Iran policy.

artifacts.bundle_name: Court Filing Bundle – Alton C. Jennings Will Challenge

sub_items.description: Court petition filed December 2024 challenging the last will and testament and trust of Alton C. Jennings, naming Turning Point USA and Young America's Foundation as recipients of a redirected estate.

Host-narrated reference to Paul Vallely (Paul Vallely) as a Turning Point USA board member, described as former military commander of the 7th Psychological Operations Group, with two Vietnam combat tours and postings in Japan, Korea, Iraq, Israel, and Europe.
Reference to the 1980 book *Mind War* co-authored by Paul Vallely and Major Michael Aquino.
Audio interview clip of Michael Aquino describing the Temple of Set's stated philosophical goals (exploring consciousness, Egyptian religious framework).

Host-narrated reference to Aquino joining the Church of Satan in 1969, rising to Magister Caverns of the fourth degree, editing *The Cloven Hoof*, and leaving in 1975 to found the Temple of Set after the LaVey/schism.
Reference to a 1986 San Francisco Police Department investigation into Michael Aquino in connection with the Army Child Development Center.
Reference to a 1987 victim identification of Aquino; case closed for insufficient evidence despite victim describing the house involved.
Article reference reporting twelve lawsuits filed against Harvest Christian Fellowship and Greg Laurie in connection with alleged abuse at a children's home in Bucharest, Romania.

Reference to original September lawsuit by two men against former Harvest pastor/missionary Paul Havsgaard (Havsgaard) alleging abuse at the Romanian children's shelter, including children tied to radiators, kneeling on walnut shells, inappropriate touching, and sex trafficking.
Reference to law firm news release stating twenty-three former residents of the home are expected to bring complaints; most recent complaints filed November (year implicit in context).
News reference to the death of Scott Adams (Dilbert creator) at age 68 from prostate cancer, with host noting he stated he was "coming to the Lord" before death.

sub_items.description: Reference (host-cited) to Social Blade data showing Erika Kirk deleted 126 Instagram posts on June 19, framed in context of the master timeline.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Argued Against Broader US Military Involvement in Iran
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk, in his own recorded words, argued against broader US military engagement with Iran and against neocon calls for regime change.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain primary recording and timestamp; verify quote against original source; confirm date of recording.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Criticized Lindsey Graham's Iran Regime-Change Rhetoric
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Charlie Kirk criticizes Lindsey Graham's call for regime change in Iran as analogous to Hillary Clinton's Libya intervention.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain primary recording; verify exact phrasing.

claims.label: Host Says Court Petition Filed December 2024 Challenges Alton C. Jennings Will Against TPUSA and YAF
claims.claim: The host says, per the lawsuit (which she notes contains only allegations), that a court petition was filed in December 2024 by Alton C. Jennings's grandson, challenging his last will and trust and alleging cognitive decline and that caretaker Mitch Manley Sr. isolated him and seized control of his finances.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain docket records (case number, court, jurisdiction); verify filing date and parties; confirm allegations are pleaded in the petition.

claims.label: Host Says Alton C. Jennings Estate Valued at $25M; Will Changed November 2023, Four Months Before Death
claims.claim: The host says Alton C. Jennings's estate was valued at $25 million, and that his will was changed in November 2023, approximately four months before his death at age 95.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain probate court filings; verify valuation and date of will execution.

claims.label: Host Says Mitch Manley Jr. Worked on Charlie Kirk's TPUSA Show While His Father Was Caretaker
claims.claim: The host says Mitch Manley Jr. (son of caretaker Mitch Manley Sr.) was employed by Turning Point USA on Charlie Kirk's show during the period his father was serving as Alton Jennings's caretaker.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify employment records; cross-check TPUSA staff listings; obtain dates of employment.

claims.label: Host Says Jennings Estate Was Split Between Turning Point Action and YAF
claims.claim: The host says the Jennings estate was split between Turning Point Action (headed by Tyler Bowyer) and Young America's Foundation (YAF).
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain probate records reflecting beneficiary designations; verify allocation.

claims.label: Host Identifies Paul Vallely as a TPUSA Board Member and Former Commander of the 7th PSYOP Group
claims.claim: The host identifies Paul Vallely as a Turning Point USA board member, with a military background as commander of the 7th Psychological Operations Group and two Vietnam combat tours.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify TPUSA board membership via official TPUSA disclosures; cross-check military service record.

claims.label: Host Says Vallely and Aquino Co-Authored Mind War in 1980
claims.claim: The host says Paul Vallely and Major Michael Aquino co-authored the book *Mind War* in 1980.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain bibliographic record (publisher, ISBN); verify authorship.

claims.label: Host Says Michael Aquino Joined the Church of Satan in 1969
claims.claim: The host says Michael Aquino joined the Church of Satan in 1969 and rose within its hierarchy.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check Aquino's published biographical statements; consult Church of Satan archives.

claims.label: Host Says Aquino Founded the Temple of Set in 1975
claims.claim: The host says Michael Aquino left the Church of Satan in 1975 and founded the Temple of Set after a doctrinal dispute over whether Satan was literal or metaphorical.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify founding documents; cross-check Temple of Set records.

claims.label: Host Says SF Police Investigated Aquino in 1986 re: Army Child Development Center
claims.claim: The host says that in 1986, San Francisco police opened an investigation into Michael Aquino in connection with allegations of sexual abuse at the Army's Child Development Center in San Francisco.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain SFPD case records (case number); verify closure status and stated reason.

claims.label: Host Says 1987 Victim Identified Aquino; Case Closed for Insufficient Evidence
claims.claim: The host says that in 1987 a girl came forward identifying Aquino as the perpetrator, but the case was closed for insufficient evidence, despite the victim reportedly describing the house where abuse occurred.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain SFPD records; review any subsequent civil filings; cross-check victim statements if available.

claims.label: Host Says Twelve Lawsuits Filed Against Harvest Christian Fellowship re: Romanian Children's Home
claims.claim: The host, citing an article she shows, says twelve lawsuits have been filed against Harvest Christian Fellowship and Greg Laurie alleging abuse of young men at a children's home in Romania.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain court filings (case numbers, jurisdiction); verify plaintiff count.

claims.label: Allegations Include Specific Abuse Categories at Romanian Shelter
claims.claim: The host says the allegations against Paul Havsgaard at the Bucharest children's shelter include children being tied to radiators, made to kneel on walnut shells, touched inappropriately, and pimped out for sex.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original complaint; verify specificity of allegations; confirm Havsgaard's status (former pastor/missionary).

claims.label: Twenty-Three Former Residents Expected to File Complaints
claims.claim: The host says the law firm representing the survivors said in a news release that it expects 23 former residents of the Romanian children's home to bring complaints, and that the most recent complaints were filed in November.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain law firm press release; track complaint filings in docket.

claims.label: Host Says Scott Adams Died at 68 From Prostate Cancer
claims.claim: The host says Scott Adams, creator of Dilbert, died at 68 after losing his battle with prostate cancer, and that he said he was coming to the Lord before he passed.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check obituary; verify cause of death and date.

claims.label: Host Says Social Blade Shows Erika Kirk Deleting 126 Instagram Posts on June 19
claims.claim: The host says that on June 19 Erika Kirk deleted 126 Instagram posts, according to Social Blade.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain direct screenshot of Social Blade historical record; verify count and date; archive any recovered posts.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson Compared Lindsey Graham's Behavior to a Drunk Girlfriend During DUI Stop
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Tucker Carlson compares Lindsey Graham's foreign-policy behavior to a drunk girlfriend screaming at a cop during a DUI stop.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original clip; verify date and outlet.

claims.label: Comment From Anthony Aguilar Says He Was Arrested in Congress on September 3 for Calling Out AIPAC
claims.claim: A comment the host reads, attributed to Anthony Aguilar, the Gaza whistleblower Green Beret, says he was arrested on the 3rd of September in Congress for calling out AIPAC.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify arrest record (US Capitol Police, court records); verify date; obtain any charging documents or dismissals.

claims.label: Anchor Plane Arrived in Provo May 23; SUBTU Followed May 27 With Wed Mahmoud Aboard
claims.claim: The host says, per her master timeline, that an anchor plane landed in Provo on May 23 and a follow-up plane, tail number SUBTU, came in on May 27 with Wed Mahmoud aboard, and that she has confirmed these planes can trick their transponders so the flights do not show on flight radar; she says it departed Provo on June 2.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain flight records (FAA, Flightradar24 archives); cross-check tail number; verify passenger manifest if available. **[Optional Flag: Artifact verbally referenced but not shown in this episode]**

claims.label: Host Asserts Iran–Israel 12-Day War Commenced June 13 Following Plane Departures
claims.claim: Host asserts that the Iran–Israel 12-day war commenced on June 13, immediately following the SUBTU plane's reported departure from Provo on June 2.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify conflict onset date via public news records; cross-check host's timeline against flight records.

claims.label: Host Says Ackman Confirmed His Presentation Urging Young People Not to Own Property
claims.claim: The host says that when she spoke to influencers at a retreat, Bill Ackman (transcribed as "Bill Ackman") confirmed that he gave a presentation encouraging younger generations not to own property.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the retreat and the influencers present; obtain a recording, slides or an Ackman statement confirming the presentation.
claims.transcript_snippet: Bill Ackman confirmed it that he gave this presentation to encourage younger generations not to own property.

claims.label: Host Says Private Equity and Unnatural Disasters Are Feeding a Global Land Grab
claims.claim: The host says private equity is buying up large amounts of land and that unnatural disasters then make land very cheap, as part of a global land grab accompanied by war.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare property-transfer and private-equity purchase filings in areas hit by named disasters; the host offers no specific case here.
claims.transcript_snippet: private equity buying a bunch of land. Then you have these unnatural disasters and suddenly land super cheap

claims.label: Host Says Per Tucker Carlson That Kirk Went Head to Head With Netanyahu in June 2025
claims.claim: The host says that during June 2025, according to Tucker Carlson and others who have spoken about it, Charlie Kirk went head to head with Benjamin Netanyahu.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Tucker Carlson's own accounts of his June 2025 conversations with Kirk and any message records between Kirk and Trump circle figures.
claims.transcript_snippet: because we know that during the month of June, according to Tucker Carlson and other people who have come out and spoken about this, Charlie goes head to head with BBNet and Yahoo.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Lobbied Trump in June to Limit Action to Iran's Nuclear Sites
claims.claim: The host says Kirk lobbied President Trump in June not to get involved in Israel's war with Iran, saying any action should be limited to taking out the nuclear sites.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek contemporaneous reporting, Kirk show audio from June 2025, or Trump-circle accounts of Kirk's advice before the strikes.
claims.transcript_snippet: He lobbies in the month of June for President Trump not to get involved in Israel's war with Iran. He says just limit it to taking out their nuclear sites.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Was Adamant a War With Iran Would Not Benefit Trump or the American People
claims.claim: The host says Kirk was adamant that a war with Iran would not benefit the Trump campaign or the American people.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the dated Kirk audio the host plays and against other recorded Kirk statements on Iran.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie was adamant that uh war with Iran would not benefit the Trump campaign and it would not benefit but would not benefit the American people.

claims.label: Graham Clip Says It Is Time to Close the Chapter on the Iranian Ayatollah
claims.claim: In the audio the host plays, a clip of Lindsey Graham says it is time to close the chapter on the Iranian Ayatollah and his henchmen and start a new chapter in the Middle East.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Graham remarks and their date to confirm the wording and the context in which Kirk replayed them.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's time for us to close the chapter on the Iranian Ayatollah and his henchmen and start a new chapter in the Middle East.

claims.label: Tucker Says Flighty, Emotionally Incontinent People on Foreign Payrolls Should Not Make an Empire's Decisions
claims.claim: In the clip the host plays, Tucker Carlson says an empire should not have flighty, emotionally incontinent, silly people on the payroll of foreign nations making its decisions, and gives Lindsey Graham as an example.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Tucker Carlson segment to verify date, outlet and exact wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: What you don't want are flighty, emotionally incontinent, silly people on the payroll of foreign nations making the decisions in an empire cuz that's how you get in trouble.

claims.label: Host Speculates Israel Holds a Blackmail File on Lindsey Graham
claims.claim: The host says she personally thinks Lindsey Graham has the largest blackmail file and that whatever Israel has on him is terrifying; she offers this as speculation, with no document shown.
claims.investigative_direction: No evidence is shown. Any public record or named source supporting the existence of such a file would be needed; treat as the host's opinion until then.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think personally he's got the largest blackmail file. Whatever Israel has on him, it is terrifying.

claims.label: Host Says Male Escorts Alleged a Sophisticated Blackmail Ring in DC
claims.claim: The host says male escorts have come forward and made allegations that they were running a pretty sophisticated blackmail ring in DC, which she raises while discussing what Lindsey Graham probably gets up to.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the escorts and the public reporting or court records behind the allegations; no names or sources are given on air.
claims.transcript_snippet: We've had some male hookers come out come out and make some allegations, but they were running a pretty sophisticated blackmail ring in DC.

claims.label: Graham Clip Says Trump Will Kill the Ayatollahs if They Keep Killing Their People
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Lindsey Graham tells the Ayatollahs that if they keep killing people who are demanding a better life, Donald J. Trump is going to kill them; the clip is introduced as coming in the aftermath of Venezuela.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Graham post or broadcast and its date to confirm the wording and that it followed the Venezuela operation.
claims.transcript_snippet: you need to understand if you keep killing your people who are demanding a better life, Donald J. Trump is going to kill you.

claims.label: Host Says Egyptian Planes Follow a Pattern of an Advance Plane Arriving Before the VIP Plane
claims.claim: The host says that from the pattern she sees with the Egyptian planes, an anchor plane arrives before the plane carrying the important passenger, possibly to scope the place first.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare arrival dates of the SUBND and SUBTU aircraft at Provo and other U.S. stops across 2022 to 2025 flight data.
claims.transcript_snippet: in terms of the patterns that I'm seeing with the Egyptian planes, it gets there before their uh their A-lister arrives

claims.label: Host Says Flight Radar Would Show SUBTU Circling Cairo Rather Than Flying to Provo
claims.claim: The host says that on a flight radar lookup the tail number SUBTU would appear to be flying around in circles in Cairo and the trip to Provo would not be visible.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull ADS-B Exchange and Flightradar24 history for SU-BTU for May and June 2025 and compare with any Provo airport logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's going to look to you like this tail number SUBTU is just flying around in circles in Cairo.

claims.label: Host Says Wed Mahmoud on SUBTU Is the Same Name Later on the Yellow Plane on the Assassination Day
claims.claim: The host says the Wed Mahmoud who was aboard SUBTU flying into Provo is the same name that will be on the yellow plane on the day of Charlie Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the manifests or FBO records for both flights and the exact spelling of the passenger name on each.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's an important name because that's going to be the same Wed Mahmoud that's going to be on our yellow plane on the day of Charlie Kirk's assassination.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Confirmed Those Planes Were in Provo
claims.claim: The host says that although the planes did not transpond, she has confirmed that those planes were in fact in Provo.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for the confirming source; compare with Provo airport and FBO records.
claims.transcript_snippet: but I have confirmed that those planes were in fact in Provo.

claims.label: Host Speculates the Departing SUBTU Could Have Gone to DC Instead of Cairo
claims.claim: The host says that because the plane did not transpond on departure it might have gone to DC rather than back to Cairo, and says she should not even say it went back to Cairo.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for arrival records at DC-area airports for an Egyptian-registered aircraft between June 2 and June 4, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: Maybe it went to DC. That plane could have actually gone to DC.

claims.label: Host Says Provo Basically Has a City Underground and Would Suit Moving a VIP Out of Israel in Wartime
claims.claim: The host says she has learned that Provo basically has a city underground, and she speculates it would be a good place to send a very important person out of Israel during wartime.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's source for the underground facility; look for public documentation of such a facility near Provo.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've learned Provo basically has a city underground.

claims.label: Host Says There Were Strange Government Cancellations in Provo at That Time
claims.claim: The host says there were some strange government cancellations in Provo during that period and defers the detail to a later Egyptian planes episode.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to specify which government events or flights were cancelled and obtain the corresponding schedules.
claims.transcript_snippet: And there were some strange cancellations, but again, I'm going to save that uh government cancellations in Provo at that time

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Lobbied for No More Involvement Between June 14 and June 21 Before Midnight Hammer
claims.claim: The host says that between June 14 and June 21, leading up to Operation Midnight Hammer, Charlie Kirk was lobbying and saying there should be no more involvement.
claims.investigative_direction: Find dated Kirk show segments or messages from June 14 to 21, 2025 that show his position before the strikes.
claims.transcript_snippet: between June 14th and June 21st leading up to our operation midnight hammer, which is when we send uh out the planes to bomb for DAO. Charlie's lobbying and saying no more involvement.

claims.label: Host Speculates Kirk May Have Asked Erika to Purge Her Instagram Because He Felt Threatened
claims.claim: Tying the June 19 deletion of 126 Instagram posts to the period of Kirk's Iran lobbying, the host speculates that Charlie may have said he felt threatened and did not want people knowing where they were going.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the Social Blade history and any archived copies of the deleted posts; look for dated travel by the Kirks around June 19.
claims.transcript_snippet: So I don't know maybe Charlie saying I feel threatened. I don't want people knowing where we're going.

claims.label: Host Says the U.S. Carried Out a Limited Bombing and Commentators Declared the Iran War Over
claims.claim: The host says the U.S. decided to bomb in a limited military exercise, after which everyone said the war with Iran was over and the people warning of a wider war were wrong, but she and her side insisted they were not wrong.
claims.investigative_direction: Cite contemporaneous coverage of Operation Midnight Hammer and statements declaring the war over.
claims.transcript_snippet: we decide to bomb for a limited uh military exercise and everyone says the war with Iran is over.

claims.label: Host Says the Pause Ended and Pressure for More Involvement Is Back
claims.claim: The host says that because Netanyahu wants what he wants, the June strikes were just a pause, and that people are now demanding the U.S. get more involved in Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Track current official statements and media coverage calling for more U.S. involvement in Iran against the host's January 2026 framing.
claims.transcript_snippet: We weren't wrong but BB wants BB gets. So this just means we're hitting pause and now we're here.

claims.label: Host Says the Iranian Street Protests Are a Color Revolution Run by the CIA and a Second Agency
claims.claim: The host says the Iranian protests are a color revolution presented as organic, naming the CIA and a second agency that the transcript renders as "MSA", though she adds she does not believe at all that the protests are organic.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host which agency she meant and what evidence she has; compare with reporting on the origin of the Iranian protests.
claims.transcript_snippet: they're taking to the streets demanding freedom really CIA and MSA if you haven't done this literally in every country

claims.label: Host Says Kirk's Assassination Was Obviously a Good Thing for Netanyahu's Iran War Ambitions
claims.claim: The host asserts that Charlie Kirk's assassination was obviously a good thing for Benjamin Netanyahu's war ambitions in Iran; she states a benefit and does not say here that Netanyahu was involved.
claims.investigative_direction: This is an inference about who benefited; compare with documented Kirk and Netanyahu exchanges and with the host's earlier claims on Netanyahu's offer to Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: which was obviously a good thing for BB Netanyahu, his war ambitions in Iran.
